Screen-space ambient occlusion for volume rendering
The goal of this topic is to track the feasibility and interest for implementing SSAO for volume rendering in VTK / 3DSlicer. As highlighted by @lassoan in this post, SSAO for volumes could be a game-changer especially for the recent (and outstanding) colorized volume visualization presented here.
